/about-us/.description: Meet Krawl Through Krakow, organising Krakow pub crawls since 2008. Learn about our local team, nightly crawl and guest reviews.

/about-us/how-to-join/.description: Join Krawl Through Krakow's pub crawl at 9 PM every night. Book your ticket online and meet the guides at Adam Statue in Krakow's main market square.

/meeting-point/.role: Regular crawl meeting instructions, not NYE
/meeting-point/.description: Find Krawl Through Krakow at Adam Statue in the main market square at 9 PM. Look for the guides with the big pink Pub Krawl sign.

/new-years-eve/.role: Current NYE pub crawl sales page; product 32 handles booking
/new-years-eve/.description: Celebrate New Year's Eve in Krakow with our pub crawl on 31 December 2026. Choose the 5 PM or 7:30 PM group; meeting points are to be confirmed.

/krakow-nightlife/.role: Nightlife advice hub, not a duplicate booking page
/krakow-nightlife/.description: Explore Krakow nightlife with Krawl Through Krakow: bars and clubs, getting around, paying for drinks and practical advice for your night out.

/wheres-the-cheap-places-to-drink-in-kra.role: Existing budget-drinks guide; venue and price refresh still pending
/wheres-the-cheap-places-to-drink-in-kra.description: Looking for cheap places to drink in Krakow? Explore our guide to budget-friendly bars, pubs and drinking spots in the Old Town and Jewish Quarter.

/krakow-stag-do/.description: Plan a Krakow stag do with Krawl Through Krakow. Explore group activities and nightlife options, then enquire about a trip tailored to your group.

/krakow-hen-do/.description: Plan your Krakow hen do with Krawl Through Krakow. Explore hen party activities and nightlife ideas, and enquire about a celebration for your group.
